name: Galaxy Bearings Limited
about: Galaxy Bearings Limited engages in the manufacture and trade of ball and taper roller bearing, and steel products in India. The company offers single and double row tapered roller; single and double raw cylindrical rollers; wheel hub bearings; and other specialized bearing solutions, which include truck hub and repair insert units. Its bearings are used in taper roller applications, including special wheel axle and gear boxes in automobiles, ball bearings, light and heavy machine tools, compressors, stationary diesel engines, and earth moving and material handling equipment. The company serves OEM and replacement markets. It also exports its products. Galaxy Bearings Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
